title: Hinomori Shizuku — Unseasonable Snowfall〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, these are for Minori and Haruka. These are for Miku and the others, and—

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Shizuku, I'm here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, come in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you for stopping by.
I was just dividing up all the gifts I got for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's fine. You said you have something for me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, here's your souvenir.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? I thought the okaki crackers in the living room were your souvenir for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, for the whole family. This is just for you, Shii. So, here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, are these...comfits?
Wow, they look like little stars. And they twinkle...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I know! They do that apparently because they're more transparent than regular comfits.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please share them with Honami and the others if you get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, I will.
Thanks for getting me these, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.
bgm_area00002
The next day
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Shizuku, Airi, you're both back from your trip.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we just got back yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we brought quite a few souvenirs back. We'd like to give you your gifts now if possible.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you got us gifts...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
From Kyoto of all places.
I'm looking forward to hearing all about what you did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's hand these out before we start practicing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... These are from the both of us for all of you! It's this shop's most popular item, mutsuhashi!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi, Shizuku♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have some for you two as well, Minori, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, mutsuhashi!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These have red bean paste in them... And oh, these ones don't have any filling at all?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we were surprised as well. That's why we decided to get them. We also found these...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Grapefruit-flavored mutsuhashi gummies...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The grapefruit part sounds good, but did they really have to turn them into gummies...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I think it's a nice twist.
Do you know what they taste like?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Dunno. Shizuku said they were good after trying them, so I'm sure they taste okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We still have quite a few things to give out. Next, we have...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, this is for you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, did you get something for each of us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Shii had the same reaction when she received her gift last night.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When we were in the shop, we saw all sorts of things that we thought each of you might like.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. It would be harder to narrow it down to just one thing, so that's why we got something different for each person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, here. We thought you'd really enjoy these when we saw them, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, crystal candy... These are beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, they look like ice...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, thanks for bringing up a good point!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We thought these looked like ice from Antarctica at first! Which is why we also got you these!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, penguins...? Are these candy sculptures...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's a momma and her baby!
That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This shop lets customers ask for whatever animals they like to be made on demand.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it was pretty cool since you also got to watch them being made! And they only had a few seconds to sculpt them before the candy solidified!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, Airi, thank you very much for getting me these.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'll make a little diorama with the crystal candy and penguins when I get home. And I'll take some pictures of them while I'm at it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I bet that's gonna look so cute♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I hope you'll share them with us later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I'll show you all next time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka got such a great gift...
So, um... Does this mean you also have something for...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course we do. Right, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! We actually got your gift at the same shop, Minori! You won't believe what they made!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, lemme guess!
Haruka got penguins, so... I know! Samo in candy form!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Did she guess right...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're next, Miku! These are for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to ruin your surprise! Can I still have my gift...? Please...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Be glad this isn't a TV shoot because you would've just ruined the entire segment! Anyway, here's Samo!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow!
Thank you! Thank you both so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I doubt you'll be able to guess the other thing we got you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? What other thing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ta-daaa...!
It's kintaro candy of your face!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, whoa!
All of these little slices have Minori on them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They made it based on a drawing Airi made of you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We couldn't believe the result since we weren't quite sure how accurately they'd follow the drawing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, talk about craftsmanship!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori♪
Mind smiling the same way for us as the candy version of you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Uhh... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't tell you two apart.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka and Minori both seem to really like what we got for them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it was definitely worth the time and effort.
